assets.ink-shell-v3.png: Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: TEXT-FREE production screen shell/background for a premium Chinese wuxia indie RPG character equipment menu, 3:2 landscape canvas. This is the actual game interface art layer, not a promotional poster. Art direction: sophisticated Chinese woodblock and brush ink on lightly aged ivory xuan paper, vermilion red accents, charcoal ink, subtle muted celadon. Refined restrained ink lines, flat hand-printed textures, paper fibers, restrained uneven brush edges. All elements share one deliberate illustrative style, no photorealism, no gold filigree, no leather/wood UI, no metallic fantasy borders, no software-dashboard cards. Full screen composition planned in normalized coordinates: top 0-12% nearly blank quiet pale paper for code-rendered game header and resources; left/center 5%-61% from y15%-81% is an airy light ink landscape with distant mountain washes, a faint circular brushstroke behind the central character position at x34%, and a grounded ink stone ledge near y78%, reserved for a transparent full-body standing character. NO character in this asset. Thin decorative horizontal red ink strokes and sparse floating leaves lead toward the figure; left edge has an upright subtle black ink bamboo branch. Right 65%-96% x, y17%-80% is quiet nearly blank pale paper for text data and four compact stat rows, subtly separated from the character area by a single thin vertical brush line with a small red seal-like square. Do not draw individual rows or boxes in that region, leave it quiet. Bottom y85%-98% is an elegant charcoal ink navigation band, with four equally spaced understated little ivory-red diamond ornaments at x15%,38%,61%,84%, and enough quiet space for labels. No individual button frames. The main illustration should be nuanced and beautiful but leave text regions clean and legible. Strong intentional 2D game art direction, attractive enough to be a paid indie game menu. ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT, no letters, no Chinese characters, no numerals, no UI icons, no equipment slots, no people, no fake scribbles, no logo, no watermark. Palette primarily ivory and charcoal with 5% vermilion, not brown parchment.
